title: quercus macrophylla var. rugosa
intro: Quercus macrophylla var. rugosa, commonly known as the large-leafed or rugose-leafed evergreen oak, is a plant species in the Fagaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower cholesterol levels, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus macrophylla var. rugosa include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antihyperlipidemic, and antioxidant agent, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
